mapper.sql:
select ${resource.idColumn} as id, #{resource.pathValue} as resource, ${resource.codeColumn} as item_code, ${resource.nameColumn} as item_name,
parent_id, null as parent_id,
category_id, null as category_id,
series_id, null as series_id,
option_set_id, null as option_set_id,
selection_mode, null as selection_mode,
spec, null as spec,
unit, null as unit,
status, sort_order, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ${resource.tableName}
mapper.select: select option_value.option_value_id as id, 'option-value' as resource, option_value.option_value_code as item_code, option_value.option_value_name as item_name, null as parent_id, null as category_id, null as series_id, option_value.option_set_id, null as selection_mode, null as spec, null as unit, option_value.status, option_value.sort_order, option_value.del_flag, option_value.create_by, option_value.create_time, option_value.update_by, option_value.update_time, option_value.remark from masterdata_option_value option_value join masterdata_option_set option_set on option_set.option_set_id = option_value.option_set_id and option_set.del_flag = '0' and option_set.status = '0' where option_value.del_flag = '0' and option_value.status = '0' order by option_value.sort_order asc, option_value.option_value_id desc
where ${resource.idColumn} = #{id} and del_flag = '0' limit 1 for update
select category_id from masterdata_product_category where category_id = -1 for update
where del_flag = '0' order by ${resource.idColumn} asc for update
mapper.insert: insert into ${resource.tableName}( ${resource.codeColumn}, ${resource.nameColumn}, parent_id, category_id, series_id, option_set_id, selection_mode, spec, unit, status, sort_order, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{record.itemCode}, #{record.itemName}, #{record.parentId}, #{record.categoryId}, #{record.seriesId}, #{record.optionSetId}, #{record.selectionMode}, #{record.spec}, #{record.unit}, #{record.status}, #{record.sortOrder}, #{record.delFlag}, #{record.createBy}, sysdate(), #{record.remark} )
